catalysts.name: Lyra QPU — 100+ Qubit Launch Q4 2026
catalysts.description: Rigetti's Lyra quantum processing unit (QPU) is slated for Q4 2026. Lyra represents a major leap: 100+ qubits with improved coherence times and error rates. This is the most important product milestone in Rigetti's history — the first QPU that can tackle real-world optimization problems at commercial scale.

catalysts.name: Government + Academic Partnership Expansion
catalysts.description: Post-EO: DARPA, DoE, and NSF are all accelerating quantum procurement. Rigetti has existing partnerships with DARPA, NASA Ames, and multiple national labs. The EO creates a 90-day window for agencies to identify quantum procurement needs — Q3 2026 contract announcements are likely.
